rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with the Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) API to enable breach data lookups and password security checks. Supports checking email addresses against known data breaches, retrieving details about specific breaches, verifying password exposure using k-anonymity hashing, and searching paste dumps for compromised accounts. Requires a HIBP API key for authenticated access.
